method: packet_tools.apply_edits, each member in a separate temporary copy of its current target file; no product file modified and no mutant executed

members.label: A1 acknowledge every queued Event, cursor-style
A2 replay only while no exchange is open and the Execution is live (validation effectively first)
A3 no writer-epoch fence
A4 takeover mints a new Activation ID
A5 takeover leaves the epoch where it was
A6 Effects silently stripped instead of refusing the Outcome
A7 no B-5 terminal disposition at complete/fail
A8 terminal disposition recorded as acknowledgment
A9 redelivery ignores recovery holds
A10 takeover allowed while pinned code is unavailable
A11 unknown envelope fields ignored
A12 Emission identity from a coordinator-wide counter
A13 progress observed twice (validation and retention read separately)
A14 Emission capacity checked only after every element is read
A15 await accepted as continue
A16 an accepted Outcome keeps the exchange open (a second writer can commit)
B1 control falls back to visibility (inspect-only may take over, declare and report)
B2 recovery history dropped (holds leave no History)
B3 permitted-action inspection desynchronized (protocol hold lists declaration instead of takeover)
B4 delivery attribution lost (every delivery pinned to epoch 1)
B5 acceptance index gaps (every Outcome consumes two positions)
B6 no post-callback revalidation (outer takeover commits on stale pre-callback state)
B7 Outcome hold-ending history built but never appended (resolves yet explains nothing)
B8 ordinary visibility authorizes Outcome submission (no attempt grant required)
B9 hold-ending History claims control power for a Runtime submission
B10 ordinary redelivery rotates the Runtime attempt grant
B11 redelivery rotates only a takeover attempt grant
B12 content validated before submission authority (grant check moved after content, K12-R9-EVID-01)
B13 capacity validated before submission authority (capacity check moved before grant check, K12-R9-ORDER-01 neighbor)
B14 malformed claim reports only claim defects after authority (content defects silently dropped, K12-R10-EVID-01)
B15 skip all currency when either numeric claim member is malformed (K12-R11-ORDER-01 defective family)
B16 epoch-only partial fix, base-half currency dropped (K12-R11-ORDER-01 incomplete repair)
B17 malformed Activation identity refused before replay and terminal (decision-02 early return)
B18 malformed Activation identity treated as naming another exchange (decision-02 stale instead of authority/content)
B19 malformed-identity diagnostic returned or retained before submission authority (decision-02 identity check after currency)
B20 malformed Activation identity rendered in a pre-content refusal reason (decision-02 disclosure)

k12-mutation-a12.gap: The oracle compares the answer with the Emissions retained by that same decision; a shared counter can make both agree. It has no cross-scope counterfactual for Emission identity.
